title: Methotrexate with folinic acid rescue
schedule_label: Four injections on alternate days, each followed 24 hours later by a rescue tablet.
schedule_summary: Methotrexate 50 mg is given into a muscle on days 1, 3, 5 and 7. Write down the actual time of each injection. A new cycle starts every 14 days. Take folinic acid 15 mg by mouth exactly 24 hours after each injection. Contact the unit immediately if a tablet is late, missed or vomited. Ask the team what to do before taking another dose.
purpose: Cure low-risk disease and use serial hCG blood tests to confirm the response and detect a recurrence.
indication_text: Low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (FIGO score 6 or less).
administration_text: Methotrexate 50 mg is given into a muscle on days 1, 3, 5 and 7. Write down the actual time of each injection. A new cycle starts every 14 days. Take folinic acid 15 mg by mouth exactly 24 hours after each injection. Contact the unit immediately if a tablet is late, missed or vomited. Ask the team what to do before taking another dose.
monitoring_summary: Measure serum hCG and review the trend alongside blood count, kidney and liver tests.
review_status: Feasibility build. Clinical, pharmacy and patient review pending.

common_effects.title: How you feel between visits
common_effects.text: Tiredness, nausea or appetite changes can make everyday activities harder. Ask your team for help if symptoms interfere with eating or drinking.

serious_effects.title: Mouth ulcers · Methotrexate
serious_effects.text: Report sores that affect eating or drinking before your next injection.

serious_effects.title: Liver changes · Methotrexate
serious_effects.text: Tell the team about other medicines and attend liver blood tests.

serious_effects.title: Allergic reaction · Folinic acid
serious_effects.text: Seek urgent help for swelling or difficulty breathing after the rescue medicine.

evidence.title: Charing Cross low-risk cohort
evidence.interpretation: Low-dose methotrexate and folinic acid achieved remission for many patients. A rising or plateauing hCG led to reassessment and treatment changes.
evidence.limitations: This specialist-centre cohort was observational. Ongoing hCG testing is essential even after a response.

phases.text: The pregnancy hormone hCG helps track this disease. Your team continues treatment for three cycles after it returns to normal and arranges further blood tests.
